title: 设计Redis持久化磁盘逼近容量上限时的写入保护项目。
body:
持久化磁盘接近容量上限，AOF重写还需要临时空间且业务持续写入。交付增长模型、重写余量、写入保护与恢复门槛；验证重写失败及拒写后的应用行为。不得删除未知AOF片段来恢复空间，关键数据需有已验证恢复来源。

## 操作任务：隔离故障案例：文件预算失败后的有界写入保护
本练习只运行提供的非root、自有Redis7.2临时实例。teacher对该已核实PID设置RLIMIT_FSIZE软限额，让真实BGSAVE子进程写临时RDB报EFBIG；不填满宿主磁盘，不修改挂载/sysctl/父进程限额。保留非空save规则，观察rdb_last_bgsave_status=err及真实MISCONF，旧RDB字节不能被破坏。GET仍可读，PING在此Redis版本可能同样被MISCONF阻止，不能把它单独当作服务死亡证据。
初始task.py在持久化失败后关闭stop-writes-on-bgsave-error并继续写入，导致未经恢复确认的业务写被内存接受。运行python3 reproduce.py可看见真实错误行为；修复task.py，让读取保持可用，写入在明确健康和获准条件下才进入Redis。不得自行CONFIG SET、SAVE/BGSAVE或改变进程限额“修复”保护；恢复由练习teacher完成。

## 公开API与输入
guarded_request(command,request)。command是显式连接本题私有实例的现有Redis命令回调，不接受外部地址。request为精确字段dict：GET是{'op':'GET','key':...}；SET是{'op':'SET','key':...,'value':...,'authorized':bool}。key是1..64字符可见ASCII（码点33..126）；value为UTF8编码最多4096字节的字符串，空字符串允许。其他操作/字段/类型/长度非法须ValueError，并在任何Redis调用之前拒绝；不得修改借用request。仅处理这次GET/SET，不进行隐式重试或其他业务写。

## 原生门禁与返回
必须实际查询当前save配置、stop-writes-on-bgsave-error及INFO persistence，而非固定健康值。guard精确含save_configured（save字符串非空）、protection_enabled（配置yes）、rdb_status（真实rdb_last_bgsave_status字符串）、bgsave_in_progress（真实0/1）、healthy。healthy等于save_configured AND protection_enabled AND rdb_status=='ok'；正常后台保存进行中本身不构成失败。
GET不受写门禁影响，实际GET请求key，返回其真实字符串或None，不做业务写。SET拒绝原因优先级：authorized=False -> unauthorized；无save规则 -> save_rules_missing；保护不是yes -> protection_disabled；rdb_status不是ok -> persistence_error。被拒绝的请求不发送SET，仍保留原键值和配置；所有门通过时只发送一次SET key value并检查OK。这只是当前内存写入确认，不宣称每次写都已同步持久化。
返回精确字典schema=1,op,key,status,reason,value,written,guard。GET的status='read',reason=None,written=False,value为实际GET结果；拒写status='blocked',reason为上述字符串,value=None,written=False；成功写status='written',reason=None,value=None,written=True。布尔必须bool，None不能混false或0；schema允许等值JSON数字1/1.0，但不能bool。不得伪造报告或忽略实际业务命令结果。

## 提交产物与验收方法：真实恢复
先验证保存失败且旧RDB不变、故障读可用、真实Redis MISCONF和应用无业务SET；只恢复文件限额不会自动清除上次保存错误，仍须拒写。teacher成功SAVE后，重新读取当前状态，获准新写才能恢复；未获准写始终拒绝。补测保护关闭/缺save规则时应用继续保守拒写，即使Redis自身可能允许写。
提交task.py，公开fixture/reproduce已提供。python3 checks/check.py的独立native连接核对实际配置、读值、命令轨迹和前后键值；实例由已知owned PID正常stop/wait并恢复其限额，不接系统Redis。环境缺少真实能力时是ENV，不伪装成业务验收通过。

## 能力边界
这是RDB保存失败路径的文件预算故障案例，不是宿主真实磁盘耗尽，也不证明AOF重写/追加/重启加载、生产容量计划或关键状态恢复水位已全部验收。原知识答案中的AOF峰值预算、备份转移、业务分类/告警责任与已验证恢复来源仍须另行交付；不得删除未知AOF或唯一恢复文件。
answer: 交付AOF增长、重写临时文件、RDB与备份共存的峰值预算，以及磁盘余量告警和业务降级责任表。区分缓存可丢失写入与关键状态写入，明确持久化失败时客户端成功语义，不以删除唯一AOF释放空间作为默认恢复动作。验收在隔离环境限制可用空间，观察重写失败、追加写入和重启加载的不同边界，保留原文件与错误证据。恢复后核对已确认业务水位和可恢复范围，再决定是否重新开放关键写入。方案应展示如何停止无界增长源和安全转移备份，不能只增加告警而不定义到达阈值后的有界拒绝行为。
review_note: 核对现有题：本题增加专用证据推理或独立项目交付，不以更改难度计新增；未在生产执行。 保留原知识答案；新增私有RDB文件预算真实失败与有界写门禁案例，非完整AOF项目验收。
rubric: 解释题述对象的正确性边界
提供答案要求的针对性证据与验收
列明故障或不确定结果的处理

files.reproduce.py:
"""Run only the provided, owned Redis file-budget scenario. No external address input."""
import json,secrets,sys
import task
from guard_fixture import GuardRedis,info

def main():
    checks={}
    with GuardRedis()as server:
        value='confirmed-'+secrets.token_hex(12);server.command('SET','business:confirmed',value);server.inject_failure();old=server.rdb.read_bytes()
        read=task.guarded_request(server.command,{'op':'GET','key':'business:confirmed'})
        blocked=task.guarded_request(server.command,{'op':'SET','key':'business:new','value':'unconfirmed','authorized':True})
        checks.update(read_preserved=read['status']=='read'and read['value']==value,failed_persistence_blocks_new_write=blocked['status']=='blocked'and blocked['reason']=='persistence_error'and blocked['written']is False,new_key_absent=server.command('GET','business:new')is None,protection_not_disabled=server.command('CONFIG','GET','stop-writes-on-bgsave-error')[1]=='yes',old_rdb_preserved=server.rdb.read_bytes()==old)
        # Reset only this owned exercise configuration after observing the learner fault.
        server.command('CONFIG','SET','stop-writes-on-bgsave-error','yes');server.restore_budget()
        early=task.guarded_request(server.command,{'op':'SET','key':'business:early','value':'x','authorized':True})
        checks['budget_alone_not_recovery']=early['status']=='blocked'and server.command('GET','business:early')is None
        server.command('CONFIG','SET','stop-writes-on-bgsave-error','yes');server.recover()
        recovered=task.guarded_request(server.command,{'op':'SET','key':'business:recovered','value':'approved','authorized':True})
        checks['successful_save_reopens_authorized_write']=recovered['written']is True and server.command('GET','business:recovered')=='approved'
        print('PUBLIC_GUARD_RESULT:'+json.dumps({'checks':checks,'verified':all(checks.values()),'observed_rdb_failure':'err','recovery_rdb_status':info(server.command,'persistence')['rdb_last_bgsave_status']},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
    return 0 if all(checks.values())else 1
if __name__=='__main__':sys.exit(main())

exercise.environment: 非root Linux、Python标准库、Redis7.2自有Unix socket实例；仅ownPID prlimit
exercise.operation: 复现真实EFBIG/BGSAVE失败后的关闭保护继续写入错误，修复持久化与授权门禁，核实际读写和恢复
exercise.validation_scope: 文件预算导致的RDB失败；不宣称AOF/生产容量/宿主磁盘耗尽验收

test_files.checks/check.py:
import copy,json,secrets,pathlib,sys
ROOT=pathlib.Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'checks'))
from guard_fixture import GuardRedis,info
from redis_native import RedisError
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
import task

def same(actual,expected):
    if type(expected)is bool:return type(actual)is bool and actual==expected
    if expected is None:return actual is None
    if isinstance(expected,(int,float)):return type(actual)in(int,float)and actual==expected
    if isinstance(expected,dict):return isinstance(actual,dict)and set(actual)==set(expected)and all(same(actual[k],v)for k,v in expected.items())
    if isinstance(expected,list):return isinstance(actual,list)and len(actual)==len(expected)and all(same(a,b)for a,b in zip(actual,expected))
    return type(actual)is type(expected)and actual==expected

def snapshot(server):
    status=info(server.command,'persistence');saving=server.command('CONFIG','GET','save')[1];protect=server.command('CONFIG','GET','stop-writes-on-bgsave-error')[1]
    guard={'save_configured':bool(saving.strip()),'protection_enabled':protect=='yes','rdb_status':status['rdb_last_bgsave_status'],'bgsave_in_progress':status['rdb_bgsave_in_progress']=='1'}
    guard['healthy']=guard['save_configured']and guard['protection_enabled']and guard['rdb_status']=='ok'
    return guard

def run_case(server,name,request):
    previous=copy.deepcopy(request);guard=snapshot(server);before=server.command('GET',request['key']);config=server.config.read_bytes();calls=[]
    def command(*parts):
        op=str(parts[0]).upper();normalized=tuple(str(v)for v in parts)
        permitted=op in ('GET','SET','INFO')or(op=='CONFIG'and len(parts)>2 and str(parts[1]).upper()=='GET')or normalized==('CONFIG','SET','stop-writes-on-bgsave-error','no')
        assert permitted,'learner must not repair configuration or persistence'
        calls.append(normalized);return server.command(*parts)
    expected={'schema':1,'op':request['op'],'key':request['key'],'status':'read','reason':None,'value':before,'written':False,'guard':guard}
    reason=None
    if request['op']=='SET':
        reason=('unauthorized'if not request['authorized']else'save_rules_missing'if not guard['save_configured']else'protection_disabled'if not guard['protection_enabled']else'persistence_error'if guard['rdb_status']!='ok'else None)
        expected.update(status='blocked'if reason else'written',reason=reason,value=None,written=reason is None)
    try:actual=task.guarded_request(command,request)
    except (ValueError,KeyError,TypeError,RedisError)as error:raise AssertionError('valid guarded request failed: '+type(error).__name__)from error
    assert request==previous,'borrowed request changed'
    assert same(actual,expected),'receipt does not match independently observed Redis guard/result'
    sets=[c for c in calls if c[0].upper()=='SET'];gets=[c for c in calls if c[0].upper()=='GET']
    if request['op']=='GET':assert gets and all(c==('GET',request['key'])for c in gets)and not sets
    elif reason is None:assert sets==[('SET',request['key'],request['value'])]
    else:assert not sets,'blocked request attempted business SET'
    assert not any(c[0].upper()=='CONFIG'and c[1].upper()=='SET'for c in calls),'learner changed protection'
    after=server.command('GET',request['key']);assert after==(request['value']if request['op']=='SET'and reason is None else before)
    assert snapshot(server)==guard and server.config.read_bytes()==config
    print('NATIVE_REQUEST_OBSERVED:'+json.dumps({'case':name,'expected_status':expected['status'],'guard':guard,'actual_business_SET':len(sets),'actual_business_GET':len(gets),'before':before,'after':after},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)

for request in [None,[],{}, {'op':'DROP','key':'x'},{'op':'GET','key':'x','extra':1},{'op':'GET','key':''},{'op':'GET','key':'a b'},{'op':'GET','key':'x'*65},{'op':'SET','key':'x','value':'v','authorized':1},{'op':'SET','key':'x','value':False,'authorized':True},{'op':'SET','key':'x','value':'é'*2049,'authorized':True},{'op':'SET','key':'x','value':'x'*4097,'authorized':True}]:
    calls=[]
    def forbidden(*parts):calls.append(parts);raise AssertionError('invalid request reached Redis')
    try:task.guarded_request(forbidden,request)
    except ValueError:pass
    else:raise AssertionError('invalid request accepted')
    assert calls==[]

with GuardRedis()as server:
    value='确认-opaque-'+secrets.token_hex(12);server.command('SET','business:read',value)
    run_case(server,'healthy-GET',{'op':'GET','key':'business:read'})
    run_case(server,'healthy-null',{'op':'GET','key':'business:missing'})
    run_case(server,'healthy-unauthorized',{'op':'SET','key':'business:denied','value':'must-not-write','authorized':False})
    run_case(server,'healthy-authorized',{'op':'SET','key':'business:normal','value':'允许-'+secrets.token_hex(12),'authorized':True})
    run_case(server,'inclusive-64-key-4096-UTF8-bytes',{'op':'SET','key':'k'*64,'value':'é'*2048,'authorized':True})
    server.inject_failure();old=server.rdb.read_bytes()
    run_case(server,'rdb-error-read',{'op':'GET','key':'business:read'})
    run_case(server,'rdb-error-deny',{'op':'SET','key':'business:fault','value':'must-not-enter-Redis','authorized':True})
    run_case(server,'rdb-error-unauthorized-priority',{'op':'SET','key':'business:denied','value':'x','authorized':False})
    assert server.rdb.read_bytes()==old
    server.restore_budget()
    run_case(server,'budget-restored-but-status-still-error',{'op':'SET','key':'business:early','value':'not-yet','authorized':True})
    server.recover()
    run_case(server,'successful-save-then-authorized',{'op':'SET','key':'business:recovered','value':'恢复-'+secrets.token_hex(12),'authorized':True})
    run_case(server,'successful-save-does-not-authorize',{'op':'SET','key':'business:denied','value':'x','authorized':False})
    server.command('CONFIG','SET','stop-writes-on-bgsave-error','no')
    run_case(server,'disabled-protection-is-not-healthy',{'op':'SET','key':'business:disabled','value':'x','authorized':True})
    run_case(server,'disabled-protection-keeps-read',{'op':'GET','key':'business:read'})
    server.command('CONFIG','SET','stop-writes-on-bgsave-error','yes');server.command('CONFIG','SET','save','')
    run_case(server,'no-save-rules-is-not-protected',{'op':'SET','key':'business:norules','value':'x','authorized':True})
    server.command('CONFIG','SET','save','900 1')
    run_case(server,'empty-value-is-valid-write',{'op':'SET','key':'business:empty','value':'','authorized':True})
print('NATIVE_PERSISTENCE_GUARD_PASSED')
